title: hex8 free-vibration modal analysis (engine.verify.reference_modal)

governing_equations.name: generalised eigenproblem
governing_equations.description: Undamped free vibration: stiffness K and mass M give mode shapes phi and natural frequencies f = omega/(2 pi). Solved dense for tiny systems, else shift-invert Lanczos.

governing_equations.name: consistent/lumped hex8 mass
governing_equations.expr: M = integral rho N^T N dV
governing_equations.description: Element mass from density rho and shape functions N; requires density_kg_m3 > 0.

assumptions: Undamped, linear — no damping, no preload / stress stiffening, no plasticity.
Isotropic homogeneous material per region; density strictly > 0.
Trilinear hex8 elements on a regular voxel grid; occupancy-sampled geometry.
At least one DOF constrained by a fixture, else the solver refuses (rigid-body modes).
Binary occupancy; a SIMP penalty in the job is ignored by design (noted in the receipt).

boundary_conditions.fixtures: clamped/pinned/slider constrain the selected node DOF exactly as in ace_fea; frequencies are of the constrained structure.
boundary_conditions.loads: none — modal analysis takes no loads; any preload/stress-stiffening effect is out of scope (see ace_buckling for load-dependent stiffness).

discretization.notes: One-voxel clamp layer adds a little artificial stiffness; frequencies come out slightly high and refine downward.

validation.ground_truth: Euler-Bernoulli clamped-free first bending frequency f1 = (1.875104^2 / 2 pi) sqrt(E I / (rho A)) / L^2 = 1063.06 Hz for L=40, b=h=8 mm, E=2.2 GPa, rho=1270 kg/m^3.
validation.direction: over-predicts frequency (stiff hex8 + clamp layer); converges downward from above toward the analytic value.

caveats: Linear modal analysis — no damping, no preload / stress stiffening, no plasticity.
Lumped-mass hex8 is slightly stiff, over-predicting frequencies.
The pin is pure Euler-Bernoulli; at L/h = 5 real Timoshenko shear would lower the exact answer a few percent, so the true discretisation stiffness is a little larger than the raw deltas.

limits_of_validity.regime: small-amplitude linear vibration about an unloaded state
limits_of_validity.resolution: pin measured at voxel h/8 and h/16; coarser grids drift stiffer
limits_of_validity.modes: lowest positive modes only; rigid-body modes require at least one constrained DOF
